title: Confidence Catch
blurb: Drag a confidence threshold to decide which answers a machine may act on.
lesson: Jev's confidence is useful: raise the threshold and the answers it acts on get safer.
why: Each message is a Choice question. Jev returns its pick with a confidence. After the race, set a threshold: answers at or above it are acted on, the rest go to a human.
A good threshold sends the doubtful answers to a person and lets the sure ones through. The slider only re-sorts Jev's recorded answers; it runs nothing new.
